usedFor: Signable sends documents for signature and Google Contacts stores people, so “Add Contact” runs “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Add Contact” in Signable, then “Create Contact” in Google Contacts
bestTemplate.why: A contact added in Signable is saved in Google Contacts too.

watchOut: “Send Envelope” is a second trigger here, so pick “Add Contact” to avoid one run per envelope.
